svg.text: The desktop stack from the hardware up, and which kind of thing each name is
Layers, top to bottom (who talks to whom)
WAYLAND: the rulebook between apps and compositor (not a program)
Apps may say: here is my picture and size. Apps may NOT say: put me on top
MAIN THREAD: one task at a time (a click, a timer, a file change).
A task that takes 200 ms freezes the whole desktop for 200 ms.
DRM/KMS: puts pixels on the screen
Entity resolution: which kind of thing is this name?
Ask of every name: is it a PROGRAM, a RULEBOOK, a ROLE,
Same word, different thing (the usual confusion)
The word Shell means two things
The word Extension means two things
The word Terminal means four things
tab: one screen in a window
The word Session means three things
How our own code decides two things are the same one
event has an agent field, else
